✦ Our Story

What is Horizon SMP?

Horizon SMP is the official continuation of CT X AGF Season 3 — reborn with a new identity and a bigger vision. A collaboration between Celestial Tamizhans and AlphaGamingg, it carries forward the legacy of CT X AGF S3 with a fresh name, stronger economy systems, and an even more united Tamil gaming community.

This is a Semi-Vanilla economy server powered by the Shards system — featuring RTP, teleport, player shops, and community events. Pure survival with the tools to make it legendary.

★ CT X AGF Legacy ⚡ Semi-Vanilla ✨ Shards Economy 📌 RTP System 🛒 Player Shop 📌 Teleport ● Season 3 Live 🌎 India Hosted 🎤 Voice Chat

⚡ Features

Why Horizon SMP?

Everything that makes us the best Tamil Minecraft server.

✨

Shards Economy

Earn, trade and spend Shards — our unique currency powering the entire player-driven economy.

📌

RTP System

Random Teleport to explore untouched lands and find the perfect spot to build your base.

🛒

Player Shop

Buy and sell items in the community marketplace. Build your shop empire and dominate the economy!

📌

Teleport System

Set homes, teleport to friends and warp to key locations instantly.

🎤

Proximity Voice Chat

In-game proximity voice for real teamwork and authentic Tamil community vibes.

🌎

India Hosted • 24/7

Ultra-low latency servers hosted in India. Always online, smooth gameplay every time.

📜 Code of Conduct

Server Rules

Keep our community fun, fair & exciting for everyone.

⚠️ This is a Horizon SMP — griefing & stealing are part of the survival experience! Play smart, protect your base, and embrace the chaos.
✓
Griefing is AllowedAllowed — You can raid and grief other bases. Build strong — protect what's yours!
✓
Stealing is AllowedAllowed — Stealing from unprotected chests is fair game. Lock your stuff to stay safe!
✓
PVP is AllowedAllowed — Player vs Player combat is permitted. Fight smart, survive longer!
4
No Hacking or CheatingGameplay — X-ray, fly hacks, kill aura, dupe glitches — any unfair advantage is an instant ban.
5
No Voice Chat AbuseVoice — Keep voice chat civil. No ear-rape, screaming, slurs or harassment over mic.
6
No Chat AbuseChat — No hate speech, targeted harassment or toxic behaviour. Banter is fine, abuse is not.
7
No SpammingChat — Don't spam chat or voice with repeated messages or sounds.
8
No Doxxing or Real-Life ThreatsSafety — Permanent ban, no exceptions. Real safety is non-negotiable.
9
No Lag MachinesTechnical — Intentional lag machines that tank server TPS are strictly banned.
10
No AdvertisingChat — Don't advertise other servers or discords without permission.
11
Respect Spawn AreaBuilding — Do not grief or loot within 500 blocks of spawn.
12
Follow Staff InstructionsCommunity — Staff decisions are final. Arguing publicly results in a mute.
13
Play Fair & Have Fun!Community — No crying over being raided — that's the game! Rebuild, fight back, enjoy! 🎮
